content.text: Summary: Checked the ticket, listed pods in `notify` and `shared-infra`, and pulled notification-worker logs. The worker is configured with the bare `SMTP_HOST=smtp-relay`, which stopped resolving after smtp-relay moved to the shared-infra namespace — DNS short names only resolve within the pod's own namespace. Resolved T-4004 with the fix: set SMTP_HOST to `smtp-relay.shared-infra` (or the full FQDN) and redeploy.
